title: 5.9 Ordering Politely 1: At a Café
unit_outcome: Name fruit, food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, ask how many and how much, and order politely at a café.
goal: Complete a polite café exchange: greeting and help, request, handover and thanks.
grammar_function: Hello! How can I help you? Can I have coffee, please? Here is your coffee. Thank you. Can I have coffee and eggs, please? Here are your coffee and eggs.
prerequisite: 3.1 greetings; 3.12 have; 5.2 food; 5.3 drinks; 5.6 wants and needs. Can I have and How can I help you are introduced here as polite fixed frames.
speaking_outcome: Request coffee, water or coffee and eggs politely, and complete the handover with thanks.
